thesis:
本期于11月20日回顾补写，只使用截至11月13日已公开的资料。四组材料给出了四个不同的验收对象：执行后能否发现偏差，动作是否符合岗位，用原用户能否读到目标数据，以及撤回请求能否传到下游。

先按时间顺序写下证据：执行前有身份、岗位及业务授权；执行中能看到原请求与实际动作；执行后有告警评分和接收方回执。每一种证据都只能回答一部分问题。没有记录、没有评分、没有回执须成为可分派的未完成状态，否则很容易被汇总表误记为成功。
takeaways: 谷歌的模拟测试把没有评分的会话另列；企业若把缺少遥测的会话视为正常，会同时低估漏报和补查工作。
岗位档案实验里的宏平均 F1 与事后排序指标属于不同任务，采购时应另量本地岗位例外、误升级和复核成本。
Oracle 的目标财务系统保留最终授权；同一测试报表既要检验经理能看到什么，也要检验无权员工确实看不到什么。
隐私圆桌的二十四项风险是待检验的分类，不是事故样本。判断撤回是否有效要跟踪下游确认和实际读回，而非只数发送请求。
contrarian: 常见主张是加一个表现足够好的监控模型，就可以减少业务工具自己的把关。来源事实是谷歌检测发生在执行之后，岗位档案论文的高分是模拟判别结果；Oracle 的指南仍由目标应用决定数据是否可见。编辑判断：若一次动作会产生不可轻易撤销的外部后果，事后发现再准也不能替代事前授权。若经过独立实地对照，能证明动作始终可无损撤回，且只做事后复核具有同等隐私结果和更低的全程成本，则可以对该项可逆动作放宽这一结论。

items.title: 87% 是事后发现率，不能当作付款前的拦截率
items.type: 工程团队评测与外部基准
items.source: 2026-11-12｜Google Developers Blog，异常检测工程团队
items.summary: 一家企业准备让代理代办差旅时，应该把异常监控放在付款前还是付款后？谷歌公布了对其代理异常检测功能的测试：它读取已经产生的运行轨迹和日志，找出偏离预期的会话，再把发现交给值班人员。研究采用五套非谷歌编写的公开基准，刻意区分代理从未读到指令、读到但未执行以及实际执行三种情况。这个区分对采购很实用：只有第三类能回答“事情已经发生，产品发现了多少”，不能回答“它替财务拦下了多少笔”。高影响动作仍需要自己的审批和支付控制。
items.design: 测试代理在模拟应用中调用工具，将日志异步送往检测服务；基准自己的程序检查应用终态来确定标签，不让同一个模型既做任务又打分。检测服务只依据运行轨迹提出发现，不能直接阻止动作。告警可送往安全运营中心，而付款、对外邮件和数据分享的批准应在业务工具执行前完成。来源没有披露客户员工查看原始轨迹的权限配置、告警处理时限或全量日志的敏感数据保留期。编辑建议上线前先明确谁能调阅日志；遇到无评分的会话标记为未检查，不允许它在仪表盘中自动变成正常。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（外部公开基准，运行和报告方为厂商）。作者给出一千七百七十四个已评分会话，在代理确实执行有害指令的子集里标出百分之八十七；正常办公类任务误报百分之二至四，在另一类含高影响工具的良性任务中升至百分之十六。长期记忆相关的已执行样本仅十八个，命中四个。约百分之六送测会话没有评分，作者称若按漏报处理，总体比率会再降一至两个百分点。基准非厂商编写使标签来源较可信，但仍是单一模型、模拟业务与厂商运行，未见独立生产复现。编辑判断是先核算本地误报复核负担，不能从该数字推断财务损失减少。
items.idea: 由差旅财务和值班人员选择已脱敏的报销会话，在不影响付款的条件下旁路给告警打分。复核人按真实业务结果分出误报、漏报和未评分，逐笔记下调查分钟数；按工具类型公布结果，另列实际付款前审批的覆盖比例，两套数字不要混算。

items.title: 流程没有禁止，岗位也未必允许：识别超出任务目的的动作
items.type: 研究预印本与模拟轨迹评测
items.summary: 一名专门处理退货查询的助手也许能读取订单，但这并不意味着它有权代表客户办其他事。研究团队提出为每个代理保存独立的意图说明，汇集组织规则、岗位职责和开发者预期，再用这份说明审查请求或已完成的动作。它针对的是常被忽略的一类差错：措辞看上去正常，权限检查也通过，却已经偏离任务目的。论文比较带说明和不带说明的判别方法，并用模拟环境的最终状态评估部分结果。企业可以从中借用“先写清岗位再测偏差”的方法，不宜直接委托判别模型替业务部门划定职责。
items.design: 论文把可信配置中的岗位意图提炼为一份档案，再试验执行前识别、执行后识别、输入对齐和系统提示加强等用途。构造评测样本时先定真值标签，再让模型生成相应语言，在已有模拟环境中则可用终态判断行为。岗位说明是来自组织侧的参照，不应由用户写进查询的内容覆盖；它也不是实际系统的访问凭据。作者没有提供企业岗位变更后的审批、档案失效或多部门意见冲突的运行流程。编辑建议让业务负责人签认每版说明，缺版本或判断矛盾时转人工，把复核结论记回工单而非擅自改授权。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（未经同行评审的作者对照实验）。自建评测含三十五种代理的八百八十七条验证样本，四类宏平均 F1 从百分之四十五升至七十九，超范围一类从百分之八升至七十六。在超过一万条已执行的模拟轨迹上，带档案的事后识别曲线下面积为零点九四九，对照方法为零点九零九。前一组衡量按类别判别，后一组衡量分数排序；两者都不能直接读作生产拦截率。生成样本和预设标签可能比现实岗位更整齐，模拟轨迹没有真实数据泄露或真实审批耗时。未见独立企业复核。编辑判断是本地试验要优先加入岗位重叠、委托过期和临时例外等困难样本。
items.idea: 给退货查询岗位写一页带生效日的职责说明，抽取一批已完成并去标识的客服请求，分别在有无说明时判别是否越界。由两位业务主管独立标注，分歧保留；观察越界召回率、误升级率以及人工裁决时间，先用于工单分流，暂不改变账户权限。

items.title: 预算助手能打开，并不等于员工能看每个成本中心
items.source: 2026-11-12｜Oracle 管理员指南 G53192-12，第七章
items.summary: 财务团队上线预算助手时，管理员容易把“同事能打开对话框”当成接入已完成。甲骨文的管理指南把这个过程拆开：谁可以设计和发布助手、用户怎样跨服务登录、谁可以读取财务数据或执行流程，是三套不同的检查。即使员工已经通过统一登录，目标财务系统仍需要验证该员工的应用角色和业务权限。这样的拆分使一个常见问题可以被定位：用户能发起问题却查不到记录，可能正是权限按预期发挥作用。验收要找业务负责人核对可见范围，不能以让所有请求都返回数据为目标。
items.design: 助手的业务对象与工具在工作室配置，通过数据源指向目标财务或企业数据管理环境；连接使用应用身份和授权机制，最后由目标系统核对业务权限后再返回数据或执行动作。工作室管理员与业务负责人承担不同任务，指南要求发布前测试身份、授权、检索、动作和性能，完成业务验证和安全审查。指南没给某家公司实际使用的模型、拒绝后的人工处理时限或每单成本。编辑建议从只读预算查询做起，出现权限拒绝时把问题交给权限负责人，记录原请求，不改用管理员身份代查；异常恢复后用原用户重新验证。
items.evidence: 证据等级：B（有版本和日期的原厂实施文档，限设计要求）。指南明确工作室配置权限、单点登录和目标系统授权不能相互替代，也写明业务流程负责人要验证回答和批准生产部署。这是可执行的架构与分工描述，并非某家企业已经正确配置的证明。文件没有披露覆盖多少客户、负向权限测试是否全部通过、响应耗时或相较原有查询界面的时间收益。采购方特别容易只用一个高权限测试账号验收，因而忽略普通账号应被拒绝的情形。编辑判断是将拒绝作为正确结果纳入验收表，并记录误拒绝给财务带来的返工；本期未找到独立上线审计或生产差错率。
items.idea: 财务系统管理员与预算负责人共同选择一张测试报表，给部门经理、跨部门同事和无权用户安排预期可见范围。三类身份分别用原界面和助手查询，由负责人对照结果；统计越范围返回、错误拒绝和结果不一致，保留可回放记录后再扩大用户范围。

items.title: 从第二个收件方查起：用户撤回同意后，谁还留着副本？
items.type: 隐私研究圆桌、会后纪要与录像
items.source: 2026-11-12｜Future of Privacy Forum 会后文章；圆桌于10月19日举行
items.summary: 用户要求删除一项购物偏好时，负责对话的助手也许已经把这项偏好交给报价助手。如果前者只清理自己的历史，后台另一份数据还可能继续影响推荐。隐私组织发布圆桌纪要，把跨系统传递、长期保留与转交其他代理放在一起讨论。与会者提出五个领域、二十四项风险的早期分类，并指出同意疲劳会使不断弹窗确认很难成为可靠控制。值得企业先做的是画清某一类数据实际去了哪里，区分已收到删除请求和已确认删除。会议没有报告一家企业已经解决了跨机构撤回。
items.design: 圆桌材料讨论用户授权与代理身份的绑定、机器可读的意图和可确定执行的规则，并强调先减少收集，再考虑复杂的隐私技术。它没有规定要用哪种模型、应保存全部会话还是选用某一种检索架构，也没有给不同机构一套互通的删除接口。编辑建议先在同一企业的两个测试服务间传递一项虚构偏好，让每个收件方只登记用途、到期日和接收记录。撤回时按收件名单逐项核销；未答复的转交隐私负责人，暂停继续分发。审计页面仅显示处理状态及负责人，未确认的数据不能显示为已经删除。
items.evidence: 证据等级：C（会议原始记录及专家判断）。可确认十月十九日举行的是四场系列中的第一场；主办方公开了回顾、录像及会后摘要，说明摘要由人工核阅。二十四项风险是供反馈的零点一版分类，并不是二十四起已验证事件；专家列出的删除与同意传播问题也没有附带受影响人数、观察期、误删率或对照组。同一活动的录像有助核对发言，并非独立效果验证。编辑认为，下游系统是否确认处理是可以测的，但“收到回执”到“所有缓存永远不再使用数据”仍有距离，需要以实际读回测试检验，且跨机构时很难观察全部副本。
items.idea: 由隐私运营人员选两个内部测试助手，仅传一项虚构偏好，再发撤回请求。一个接收方故意不回执，由负责人追查并验证停发；记录回执覆盖率、撤回后读回成功次数和人工跟进时长，明确这些结果只覆盖所选链路，不代表所有第三方。

projectIdeas.description: 财务系统负责人选一张只读测试报表，用不同员工身份对照原界面与助手，由预算主管核定例外；记录超范围、误拒绝和异常复核耗时。

projectIdeas.title: 撤回请求回执簿
projectIdeas.description: 隐私运营人员只跟踪两个内部测试系统的一类虚构偏好，人工处理未确认收件方；衡量按时回执率、撤回后可读次数和恢复跟进时间。

en.thesis:
Retrospective written November 20 using material public by November 13. Four checks require separate acceptance tests: detecting deviations after execution, matching actions to a job, reading destination data under the original identity and propagating withdrawals downstream.

Trace evidence in time: identity, role and authorization before action; requested versus actual action during execution; scores and recipient acknowledgments afterward. Each answers only part of the question. Missing records, scores and receipts must remain assignable incomplete states or dashboards can count them as successes.
takeaways: Google's simulations separate unscored sessions. Calling sessions with missing telemetry normal understates both missed incidents and investigative work.
Macro-F1 and post-action ranking measure different tasks in the intent-profile study. Measure role exceptions, false escalations and review costs locally.
Oracle leaves final authorization to the destination financial system. Test both what a manager can see and what an unauthorized employee cannot.
The roundtable's 24 risks are a taxonomy to test, not an incident sample. Measure downstream acknowledgments and actual reads, not just requests sent.
en.contrarian: A common claim is that a strong monitoring model can replace business-tool checks. Google's detector runs afterward; intent-profile scores measure simulated classification; Oracle still leaves data visibility to the destination. For actions with hard-to-reverse consequences, accurate detection after execution cannot substitute for authorization beforehand. Narrow this conclusion for a reversible action if independent field comparisons show complete lossless reversal, equivalent privacy outcomes and lower end-to-end cost under retrospective review alone.

items.title: An 87% post-action detection rate is not a payment approval control
items.source: 2026-11-12 | Google Developers Blog, anomaly detection engineering team
items.summary: For a travel agent, does anomaly monitoring belong before or after payment? Google tested a feature that reads existing traces and logs, identifies unusual sessions and sends findings for review. Five public benchmarks written outside Google distinguish instructions never read, read but not executed, and carried out. Only the last group answers how often the product noticed something that actually happened; it does not count payments prevented. Consequential actions still need separate approval and payment controls.
items.design: The agent works on simulated apps and asynchronously sends logs to a detector. The benchmark's own code inspects final application state to assign labels; the acting model does not grade itself. Findings from traces do not block actions. They can be routed to security operations; approvals for payments, external emails and data sharing belong before execution. The source does not specify customer employee access to raw traces, response deadlines or a retention policy for sensitive logs. Assign access before deployment and display unscored sessions as unchecked, never automatically healthy.
items.evidence: Evidence B: external public benchmarks, vendor-run evaluation. Among 1,774 scored sessions, 87% of the executed harmful instructions were flagged. False alarms were 2–4% on ordinary office tasks but 16% on another benign set using high-impact tools. Memory-related cases had four hits in 18 executed examples. About 6% of submitted sessions had no score; the authors say treating these as misses reduces overall rates by one to two percentage points. External benchmarks lend credibility to the labels, but a single model, simulated business tasks and vendor execution are not independent production replication. Measure local review workload before making loss-reduction claims.
items.idea: Travel finance and on-call staff score alerts on redacted past expense sessions without affecting payment. Reviewers label false alarms, misses and unscored sessions against actual workflow outcomes and record minutes per investigation. Report by tool type and separately count pre-payment approval coverage.

items.title: An action can be technically permitted and still outside the job
items.type: Research preprint and simulated trace evaluation
items.source: 2026-11-12 | Copty et al., first arXiv version
items.summary: A returns assistant may read an order without the mandate to do other things for the customer. The researchers define an intent profile for each agent from organizational, role and developer expectations, then use it to assess requests or completed actions. It targets failures that look innocuous and stay within permissions but depart from the job. Methods with and without profiles are compared, with some outcomes graded by simulated environment state. Enterprises can borrow the sequence of defining the role before testing drift; a classifier should not define the business remit.
items.design: The paper extracts profiles from trusted configuration and tests pre- and post-action detection, input alignment and system-prompt hardening. Synthetic labels are fixed before the language model generates surface text; existing simulated environments also supply outcome labels from final state. Organizational intent cannot safely be replaced by instructions embedded in a query, and it is not a credential. The paper provides no enterprise procedure for approving role changes, expiring profiles or resolving departmental conflicts. We suggest owner sign-off per version; missing or conflicting profiles should go to a human whose decision is recorded without changing access automatically.
items.evidence: Evidence B: author-run controlled experiments in a preprint. A custom benchmark of 887 validated samples from 35 agents raised four-class macro-F1 from 45% to 79% and out-of-scope F1 from 8% to 76%. On over 10,000 executed simulated traces, post-action AUROC was 0.949 with profiles versus 0.909 for the comparator. Classification across categories and score ranking do not equal a production block rate. Generated cases and preset labels may be tidier than real job definitions; simulations do not measure actual disclosure or approval delays. No independent enterprise evaluation was identified. Prioritize overlapping roles, expired delegations and temporary exceptions in local tests.
items.idea: Write a dated one-page mandate for returns inquiries and replay deidentified requests with and without it. Two supervisors label cases independently and preserve disagreements. Measure out-of-scope recall, false escalations and adjudication time. Use the result for ticket routing without changing account privileges.

items.title: Opening the budgeting assistant does not grant access to every cost center
items.summary: A budgeting team can mistake an accessible chat interface for a finished integration. Oracle's guide separates who designs and publishes an assistant, how users sign in across services, and who can read financial data or act on business processes. Even after single sign-on the destination checks application roles and business privileges. A user who can ask but cannot retrieve a record may be seeing correct enforcement. Acceptance requires the business owner to verify scope, not an objective of returning data for every request.
items.design: The studio configures business objects and tools; data sources point to the destination financial or enterprise data management environment. An application identity and authorization mechanism establish the connection. The destination checks business privileges before returning data or acting. Studio administrators and process owners have separate duties. The guide requires testing identity, authorization, retrieval, actions and performance plus business validation and security review before publication. It provides no customer model, review deadline for denials or per-case cost. Start read-only, route denials to the entitlement owner instead of rerunning as admin, and retest under the original identity after recovery.
items.evidence: Evidence B for the design requirements of a dated, versioned vendor guide. Studio rights, SSO and destination authorization are distinct, and a process owner validates responses and approves deployment. This documents an implementable architecture and responsibilities, not correct customer configuration. There is no customer sample, negative-test pass rate, latency or time savings against an existing interface. Acceptance under a single powerful account can miss intended denials for ordinary staff. Include expected refusals in the acceptance matrix and track false denials and rework. No independent rollout audit or production error rate was identified.
items.idea: A finance administrator and budget owner choose one test report and define expected scope for a department manager, a colleague in another unit and an unauthorized user. Query via both the original interface and assistant for all three identities. The owner checks overbroad access, false denials and inconsistent results before expanding access.

items.title: Start with the second recipient: who keeps a copy after withdrawal?
items.type: Privacy research roundtable, post-event report and recording
items.source: 2026-11-12 | Future of Privacy Forum post; roundtable held October 19
items.summary: When a shopper deletes a preference, the conversation assistant may already have passed it to a quoting assistant. Clearing the first history could leave a copy still affecting recommendations. A privacy roundtable examined transfers across systems, persistent state and handoffs. Speakers presented an early taxonomy of 24 risks in five domains and discussed consent fatigue, which undermines repeated confirmation dialogs. Enterprises can map one data type and distinguish a deletion request received from deletion confirmed. The event did not document successful cross-organization withdrawal in production.
items.design: The roundtable discussed binding agent identity to authorizing users, machine-readable intent and deterministic enforcement, with data minimization preceding more complex privacy technology. It prescribes no model, full-session retention, retrieval architecture or interoperable cross-company deletion interface. We propose passing one fictitious preference between two internal test services and recording recipient, purpose and expiry. Reconcile each recipient after withdrawal; send unacknowledged requests to a privacy owner and pause onward sharing. The audit view needs status and ownership; unconfirmed copies must not appear deleted.
items.evidence: Evidence C: primary meeting record and expert judgment. October 19 was the first of four planned sessions. The organizer supplied a recap, recording and human-reviewed report. The 24 risks form a version 0.1 taxonomy for feedback, not 24 verified incidents. The discussion of deletion and consent propagation reports no affected population, observation window, wrongful deletion rate or control group. Video can verify speakers' statements but is not independent validation. Recipient acknowledgments can be measured; they do not prove all caches have stopped using the data. Test later reads and recognize that not all external copies are observable.
items.idea: Privacy operations choose two internal test assistants, pass one fictitious preference and issue a withdrawal. Withhold one recipient's acknowledgment so an owner can investigate and verify that sharing stops. Track receipt coverage, successful reads after withdrawal and follow-up minutes. Results apply only to the selected path, not every third party.
